summary: All-in-one CRM, funnel and marketing automation platform for agencies and small businesses.
access_note: Needs a HighLevel account (paid subscription or trial); Private Integration tokens created in Settings.
blocker_note: No free tier found; some endpoints depend on subscription plan. Public OAuth marketplace apps require HighLevel listing.

evidence.quote: Private Integrations, to put it simply, are static/fixed OAuth2 Access Tokens.
However, access to certain API endpoints depends on your subscription plan and the permissions assigned to the token.
Private Integration tokens are used in the Authorization header, just like other Access Tokens.
No API key to create or paste.

notes: Docs site is JS rendered (stoplight/marketplace); REST is inferred from bearer-token header usage, not an explicit statement. Free-tier absence not verified from a page.
